releaseNotes:
• First Android TV / Google TV release of Hamyra — built for your remote
• Live sports with an All tab, and streams that play even outside Bangladesh
• Movies & Series in HD (Hamyra HD + MovieBox), Hindi-dubbed preferred
• Bongo free shows — Bachelor Point, Sultan Salahuddin — with an episode strip
• Ad-free YouTube, right on the big screen
• Auto Bangla subtitles on by default
• 4K / HEVC playback with an automatic VLC fallback

Thank you for your support!
